text: The index from lesson nine holds every chunk, embedded and searchable. Now it needs to actually answer something.
This lesson embeds a real employee question with the same model, text-embedding-3-small, so it's comparable to every chunk in the index.
Then it queries wrenfield-knowledge-index with a hybrid search -- vector and keyword together -- and pulls back the top five matches, top-k equals five.
Those five chunks get assembled into one labeled context block, source document attached to each one, ready to hand to a prompt.
Next: writing the system prompt that actually turns that context block into an answer.
